expected_steps.name: Connect bottom cross-frame
expected_steps.description: Overlap the two tubular cross-frames at the bottom intersection and secure them with a screw and Allen key.

expected_steps.name: Connect top cross-frame
expected_steps.description: Flip the frame over and secure the center intersection of the top crossbars with a screw and Allen key.

expected_steps.name: Attach circular tray support ring
expected_steps.description: Place the circular ring on top of the frame with recessed holes facing upward and secure with screws.

expected_steps.name: Place tray onto frame
expected_steps.description: Lower the solid circular tray onto the assembled support ring to complete the table.
